title: Dispatcher progress from an offset
statement: Let the dispatcher for $n$ procedures occur at position $\mathrm{disp}$ in a word-RAM program of word size $W$, and suppose the code there begins with that dispatcher. If $2n<2^W$, the one-register contains the word encoding $1$, and $j+k<n$, then from program counter $\mathrm{disp}+2j$ with the return-register containing the word encoding $k$, after $2(k+1)$ machine steps the program counter is $j+k$ and the return-register contains the word encoding $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Code at disp begins with the dispatcher for n procedures
